verdict.rationale: Typesense is API-first: collections, indexing, search, ranking, filtering, faceting, and even Cloud cluster configuration are all driven through documented REST/API operations (docs-4, docs-8, docs-10/11, docs-19/20), and a runtime probe confirms a full indexing+search roundtrip performed purely via API with no UI involvement (probe-rt-2). The Typesense Cloud dashboard is described as a management layer atop the same API rather than a separate feature set, and no evidence shows any capability exclusive to a UI. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement or independent audit confirming 100% UI/API feature parity (e.g., for Cloud dashboard admin actions), and documentation of an OpenAPI spec (probe-3 shows 404s for openapi.json paths).
